plugin.note: Use melee crush in the Slayer Tower basement for the low-effort task path. Carry a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer; Gargoyle Smasher automates the finisher when a hammer is in inventory.

requirements: Rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer for finishing blows
Gargoyle Slayer task for basement kills
Brittle key for the Grotesque Guardians rooftop arena
mechanics: Regular Gargoyles use melee and require a hammer finisher at 9 or lower Hitpoints.
The Gargoyle Smasher unlock automatically smashes Gargoyles if the player has a rock hammer or equivalent in inventory.
The granite hammer automatically smashes Gargoyles if equipped even without Gargoyle Smasher.
Regular Gargoyles are weak to both magic and crush, but melee is commonly used because of cost and convenience.
Gargoyles have -2 flat armour, so multi-hit weapons such as Dual macuahuitl benefit from the extra damage.
Basement Gargoyles are immune to poison and venom, while upstairs Gargoyles are not.
Protect from Melee negates all damage from regular Gargoyles.
Marble gargoyles use melee and ranged attacks plus a white-red orb special that can entrap the player.
Grotesque Guardians require more supplies, effort, stats, and gear than regular Gargoyles.
Avoid Double Trouble when killing Grotesque Guardians unless intentionally spending task count faster.

methods.label: Hammer finisher
methods.summary: Finish Gargoyles at 9 or lower Hitpoints with a hammer item or the Gargoyle Smasher unlock.
steps: Carry a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer.
Use the hammer item when the Gargoyle reaches 9 or lower Hitpoints.
Unlock Gargoyle Smasher for 120 Slayer points to automatically finish Gargoyles when a hammer equivalent is in inventory.
Equip a granite hammer to automatically smash Gargoyles even without the perk.
If both rock hammer and rock thrownhammer are in inventory, expect the rock hammer in melee distance and thrownhammer outside melee distance.
risks: Forgetting the hammer prevents kills from completing.
Rock thrownhammer has travel time; rock hammer is faster in melee distance.

methods.label: Basement semi-AFK
methods.summary: Use the basement for dense on-task Gargoyles and reset aggression twice for a low-attention trip.
steps: Use the Slayer Tower basement while on a Gargoyles task because it has many Gargoyles in a smaller area than the top floor.
Start from the north of the basement, then after the first aggression loss, run south-west.
After the second aggression loss, run east.
Use this route for roughly 30 minutes of semi-AFK combat while returning for drops, stat restores, and superior spawns.
Use Protect from Melee to negate regular Gargoyle damage if not relying on food or Guthan's healing.
notes: Raulyn stops off-task kills in the basement.
Basement Gargoyles are immune to poison and venom.

methods.label: Melee crush
methods.summary: Use crush-focused melee weapons and standard Slayer melee gear.
steps: Use crush because Gargoyles are weak to crush.
Use Dual macuahuitl when the account benefits from Gargoyles' -2 flat armour and the Blood moon set bonus.
Use Guthan's equipment for healing or AFK trips.
Use Protect from Melee to negate damage from regular Gargoyles.
Bring a hammer finisher unless granite hammer is the equipped main weapon.
Use Ring of wealth if low-attention coin pickup is useful.
risks: Marble gargoyles can interrupt low-attention trips with ranged attacks and their special orb.
Melee is common, but Magic can still be viable because Gargoyles are also weak to magic.

methods.label: Ranged safespot
methods.summary: Use Ranged where safespots are available, accepting that crowded areas make safespotting less reliable.
steps: Use Toxic blowpipe for ranged damage comparable to some melee setups.
Only rely on venom upstairs because basement Gargoyles are immune to venom.
Use top-floor or basement safespots, but account for nearby Gargoyles making safespotting less reliable.
Keep a rock thrownhammer or other finisher plan for distance kills.
Use Bow of faerdhinen, Hunters' sunlight crossbow, or Eclipse atlatl as alternative ranged weapons.
risks: Safespots are less reliable when many Gargoyles are nearby.
The basement is immune to poison and venom.

methods.label: Marble gargoyle
methods.summary: Handle Marble gargoyles as dangerous superior spawns with melee/ranged attacks and a special orb.
recommendedFor: Players with Bigger and Badder unlocked
Players wanting superior Slayer monster rewards
steps: Expect Marble gargoyles after Gargoyle kills if Bigger and Badder is unlocked.
Watch for the white-red orb special attack.
Move out of the 1x1 area to avoid heavy damage and being trapped.
Account for both melee and ranged attacks.
Use the same hammer finishing requirement as regular Gargoyles.
risks: The special attack can be dangerous if ignored.
Lower-level players should bring more food than a normal Gargoyle trip requires.

methods.label: Grotesque Guardians choice
methods.summary: Choose Grotesque Guardians only when accepting a slower, higher-effort boss trip for granite dust or pet chances.
steps: Kill regular Gargoyles on task to obtain a brittle key.
Use the brittle key to unlock the Slayer Tower roof boss arena.
Choose regular Gargoyles for faster task completion and lower supply use.
Choose Grotesque Guardians when targeting granite dust or pet rolls.
Avoid purchasing Double Trouble if trying to maximise boss kills per task.
notes: Grotesque Guardians are the only source of granite dust.
Granite dust turns cannonballs into granite cannonballs with a max hit of 35 instead of 30.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring sustain, finisher, teleport, and High Alchemy support for long Gargoyle trips.
inventory: 2 Divine super combat potions or Super combat potions
1 Prayer potion if only using Preserve and Saradomin godsword sustain
Emergency food such as sharks, karambwans, or monkfish
Slayer ring to teleport to the Slayer Tower
Rock hammer if not using granite hammer as the main weapon
Divine rune pouch or Rune pouch with Fire, Nature, law, and dust runes for High Alchemy and house teleport
steps: Bring more food than shown if lower level or expecting Marble gargoyles.
Set High Alchemy warning value around 50,000 where useful.
Use Slayer ring for fast access.
Pick up drops during aggression-reset breaks.
notes: Ring of wealth can automatically pick up frequent coin drops.

styleOptions.label: Melee crush
styleOptions.summary: Crush-focused melee with Slayer helmet, optional Guthan's healing, and a hammer finisher.

styleOptions.label: Ranged
styleOptions.summary: Ranged setup for safespots or players preferring distance kills.
